settings.heading: Trauma-Based Clinical Services in Townsend, DE
settings.subheading: We provide therapy, psychological evaluation, and group services for individuals and families. Our approach is evidence-based, relationally grounded, and attentive to the whole person.

settings.heading: Clinical Services
settings.subheading: Evidence-based care for adults, adolescents, and children.

settings.title: Individual Therapy
settings.description: One-on-one therapy for adults and adolescents navigating trauma, anxiety, grief, identity, and life transitions. Trauma-based, evidence-backed, and tailored to your goals.

settings.title: Psychological Evaluations
settings.description: Comprehensive evaluations for children, adolescents, and adults. Diagnostic clarity that informs treatment, school supports, and clinical decision-making.

settings.title: Wellness Groups
settings.description: Community-grounded groups focused on grief, creative expression, and somatic resourcing. Structured and time-limited, with open enrollment periods.

settings.heading: Clinically rigorous. Relationally warm.
settings.body:
At Center for Balanced Living, we work from a trauma-based framework, meaning we understand that symptoms, behaviors, and relational patterns are often adaptations to difficult experiences, not character flaws or fixed diagnoses.

Our clinicians integrate evidence-based modalities including EMDR, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, somatic approaches, and psychodynamic work, tailored to each client's history, goals, and nervous system.

settings.heading: Trained to a high standard.
settings.body:
Our clinicians hold doctoral and master's-level degrees in psychology and counseling. We are licensed in the state of Delaware and maintain active supervision, consultation, and continuing education.

Dr. Angela Serravalle is a licensed psychologist (Psy.D.) and licensed professional counselor (LPCMH, NCC), an EMDR Certified Therapist and Approved Consultant, and founder of the CFBL Institute for continuing professional education.

All clinicians participate in ongoing clinical supervision and peer consultation within the practice.
